```{r setup, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  collapse = TRUE,
  comment = "#>",
  fig.width = 7.5,
  fig.height = 4.6,
  dpi = 120
)
library(rgraphtool)

load_or_fallback_lesmis <- function() {
  res <- tryCatch(netzschleuder_network("lesmis"), error = function(e) NULL)
  if (!is.null(res)) return(res)
  set.seed(42)
  n <- 48L
  b <- rep(1:4, each = 12L)
  el <- list()
  for (i in seq_len(n - 1L)) {
    for (j in (i + 1L):n) {
      if (stats::runif(1L) < ifelse(b[i] == b[j], 0.35, 0.025)) {
        el[[length(el) + 1L]] <- c(i, j)
      }
    }
  }
  g <- graph_add_edges(graph_create(n, directed = FALSE), do.call(rbind, el))
  list(graph = g, positions = sfdp_layout(g, groups = b, mu = 0.4, max_iter = 80L))
}
```

This article corresponds to `demo("model_class_selection")`. Choosing among
flat vs. nested, degree-corrected (DC) vs. non-degree-corrected (NDC), and
overlapping vs. non-overlapping SBMs requires integrating over posterior
uncertainty rather than comparing only MAP point estimates. `rgraphtool`
computes the full Bayesian marginal evidence:

$$-\ln P(A) = \langle \Sigma(A, b) \rangle_{P(b \mid A)} - \mathcal{H}(b),$$

where $\mathcal{H}(b)$ is the posterior partition entropy estimated via mode
clustering.

## 1. MAP comparison across all 8 model classes

```{r map-comparison}
lesmis <- load_or_fallback_lesmis()
g <- lesmis$graph

set.seed(42)
cmp_map <- compare_model_classes(g, method = "map", nruns = 3L)
print(cmp_map)
```

## 2. Full Bayesian posterior marginal evidence

Integrating over the posterior via `method = "posterior"` properly accounts for
the Occam factor (posterior entropy) of each model class and produces a
pairwise log Bayes factor matrix.

```{r posterior-comparison, fig.height = 4.6}
set.seed(42)
cmp_post <- compare_model_classes(
  g,
  models = c("flat_ndc", "flat_dc", "nested_ndc", "nested_dc",
             "overlap_flat_dc", "overlap_nested_dc"),
  method = "posterior",
  nsamples = 150L,
  thin = 5L,
  burnin = 50L
)
print(cmp_post)

# Pairwise log Bayes factors (positive favors row over column)
round(cmp_post$log_bayes_factors, 2)

old_par <- graphics::par(mfrow = c(1L, 2L), mar = c(8, 4, 3, 1))
tab <- cmp_post$summary
graphics::barplot(
  tab$delta,
  names.arg = tab$model,
  las = 2,
  ylab = "Delta(-log P(A)) [nats]",
  col = ifelse(tab$model == cmp_post$best_model, "darkorange", "steelblue"),
  main = "Model class evidence (0 = best)"
)

ov_st <- cmp_post$states$overlap_flat_dc
ov_mat <- overlap_groups(ov_st)$matrix
n_ov <- sum(rowSums(ov_mat > 0L) > 1L)
graphics::par(mar = c(2, 2, 3, 1))
plot_marginals(
  g,
  ov_mat,
  positions = lesmis$positions,
  radius = 0.045,
  main = sprintf("Overlap flat DC (B = %d, %d overlapping)",
                 overlap_groups(ov_st)$B, n_ov)
)
graphics::par(old_par)
```
